conviction_note: The quarter was pre-released in substance when the bank raised its FY2026 pre-tax guide to DKK 825-900m on 12 Oct (stock +5.65% that day), and a Danske Bank note on 29 Oct added another +7.1% against peers' +0.6-4%. So the release carries only the Q3 detail, a possible narrowing of a range set four weeks ago, and maybe the 2030 strategy. The two guidance-side findings offset (impact_sum 0.0). abs_move is set at the ~3% European pre-released base rather than the name's own ~1.5% results-day moves, and p_up sits just under 50 because of the +17% run since the pre-upgrade close.

already_public.what: FY2026 pre-tax guide raised from DKK 750-825m to 825-900m (FY2025 771.3m), citing core earnings ahead of expectations. Made 12 days after Q3 closed, so it embeds the quarter. Same announcement confirms the Q1-Q3 report for 10 Nov 2026
H1 2026: pre-tax DKK 428m, net 326m, core earnings +15%, capital ratio 23.3%, and the earlier 13 Jul raise to 750-825m. Implies an H2 pre-tax of DKK 397-472m under the current guide
DKK 125m buyback running 19 Jun 2026 to 4 Feb 2027; DKK 83.0m (188,800 shares) done by 6 Nov; about 1,000 shares a day at DKK 498-516
Danske Bank analysis of SJF published Thursday 29 Oct; per a forum reader it embeds +23.7% net interest income growth 2026->2027. Stock +7.09% that day on 54k shares (about 2.5x normal)

new_in_release.expect: Q3 pre-tax implied by the raised guide at about DKK 200-235m. Pre-released in substance, so no surprise expected

825-900m reiterated or narrowed. The Q3 2025 release narrowed that year's range (to 750-800m), so a narrowing toward the upper half is mildly more likely than a cut. A further raise is unlikely four weeks after the last one
the 2030 strategy, which the H1 report says is due 'i fjerde kvartal 2026'. Whether it comes with this release is unknown and its sign is unknown
unknown. Payout and buyback are normally set with the FY report in February

bar: The company's own FY2026 pre-tax guide of DKK 825-900m (https://www.inderes.dk/releases/sjf-bank-opjusterer-forventningerne-til-resultatet-for-2026-1). No sourced consensus for Q3: the Yahoo consensus is empty, the inderes consensus is behind a login, and the Danske Bank note's numbers are known only second-hand. So the sell-side bar is unsourced and every finding that depends on it is capped small.
session_check: bmo (window close 9 Nov -> close 10 Nov). The 12 Oct issuer announcement confirms the report 'offentliggøres som planlagt den 10. november 2026' (https://www.inderes.dk/releases/sjf-bank-opjusterer-forventningerne-til-resultatet-for-2026-1). The bank's last two interims went out IN session, not before the open: Q1 on 07.05.2026 at 10.08 CET-local (https://www.inderes.dk/releases/sjf-bank-leverer-et-resultat-efter-skat-pa-185-mio-kr-i-1-kvartal) and H1 on 13.08.2026 at 11.07 (https://www.inderes.dk/releases/sjf-bank-leverer-et-resultat-efter-skat-pa-326-mio-kr). The inderes clock is local: it shows 08.39 for a buyback notice the Nasdaq feed stamps 07:39 UTC. A mid-morning release on 10 Nov therefore falls inside the close(D-1) -> close(D) window, so bmo is the correct window, not amc.
positioning_check: No disclosed net short position on the Finanstilsynet aggregated register as of 30-10-2026 (https://www.dfsa.dk/financial-themes/capital-market/company-announcements/aggregated-net-short-positions). Denmark discloses from 0.1%, so this zero is closer to a real zero than a 0.5%-floor zero would be. But `anchor_covered` is false and the join is on the issuer name, so it is not a positioning anchor. Change 0.0, so nobody is building or covering. No short fuel either way, and priced_lean_pct (-0.53) is just the run-up.

findings.finding: A Danske Bank analysis on Thu 29 Oct moved SJF +7.09% on about 2.5x normal volume, while Danish bank peers moved +0.6% to +4.0% that day. With the 12 Oct upgrade (+5.65%), the stock is +17% since the pre-upgrade close (451.5 -> 528). A release that only confirms an already-raised, already-priced guide meets a bar the sell-side has just lifted, including a reported +23.7% NII growth estimate for 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pre-released results days have been small: H1 on 13 Aug 2026 (after the 13 Jul raise) -1.37%, Q1 on 7 May 2026 +0.47% (Yahoo SJF.CO bars). The guidance-raise days moved more: 12 Oct +5.65%, 13 Jul 0.0% then +2.7% the next day.
findings.original_quote: "den analysen som Danske Bank ga ut sist torsdag om SJF Bank" ... "har innebygd et estimat med en stigning i nettorenteinntektene på 23,7% fra 2026 til 2027" (the analysis Danske Bank published last Thursday on SJF Bank ... embeds an estimate of 23.7% growth in net interest income from 2026 to 2027). Forum post by a reader, not the note itself.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced: that is the finding. The +7.1% day shows the note entered the price. The open question is whether the release can clear a bar raised twice in four weeks. If the market were already sceptical of that bar, the stock would have faded since 29 Oct. Instead it held 504-529 and rose 3.7% at the seal on a day the sector rose 2-3%. Sized small because the note's own numbers are only second-hand.
findings.independence: Price data from a different source (Yahoo SJF.CO and peer bars: SKJE +2.1, RILBA +0.6, LOLB +1.8, MNBA +2.1, DJUR +4.0, JYSK +0.9 on 29 Oct) confirms the move was idiosyncratic: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SJF.CO?range=2y&interval=1d

findings.finding: The release may narrow the FY range toward the upper half of 825-900m. With nine months booked, the bank narrowed the range at its Q3 2025 release (to 750-800m). Peer Ringkjøbing Landbobank's Q3 on 21 Oct moved its own FY guide to the upper end, a sign that Q3 was benign for Danish regional banks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two 2026 guidance raises moved +5.65% (12 Oct) and about +2.7% (13-14 Jul). A narrowing inside an existing range is a smaller event than either. No observed reaction on the Q3 2025 narrowing day: its exact date was not recovered.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the 12 Oct raise already carries Q3, and a narrowing only moves the midpoint by about DKK 20-40m (2-5%). If the market expected the top of the range, the stock would already be trading on the DKK 900m number. A P/E near 13 on the 862m midpoint does not look like that, but that read is an inference.
findings.independence: Ringkjøbing Landbobank Q1-Q3 2026: 'now expects 2026 net profit at upper end of DKK 2.2-2.5 bln range' (https://capital.com/en-gb/news/denmark-s-ringkjobing-landbobank-9m-core-income-rises). Peer, not counterparty: a proxy.

findings.finding: The DKK 125m buyback runs through the window: about 1,000 shares a day, about DKK 0.5m against roughly DKK 10m of daily turnover. DKK 42m remains to 4 Feb 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Known since 18 Jun 2026; weekly notices move nothing visible.
findings.original_quote: "I alt akkumuleret under aktietilbagekøbsprogrammet 188.800 [aktier] 83.024.796,00" (accumulated under the buyback programme: 188,800 shares, DKK 83,024,796)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It is published every Monday, and at about 5% of daily volume it is too small to matter. Filed at 0 because it is a sourced fact inside the window.

outside_window.finding: New 2030 strategy, which the H1 report says is due 'i fjerde kvartal 2026', most likely with targets on ROE, payout and AI-driven costs. Its date is not announced and may fall after 10 Nov, and its sign is unknown. If it lands with the Q3 report it becomes the main line of the release.

No profit warning (nedjustering), no new opjustering since 12 Oct, no insider or large-shareholder notice in that span. https://api.news.eu.nasdaq.com/news/query.action?type=json&showCompany=true&limit=200&start=0
Yahoo quoteSummary consensus for SJF.CO: empty. The inderes consensus page needs a login. No Q3 consensus sourced.
The Danske Bank note of 29 Oct itself: not found. It is known only through a Nordnet forum reader.
Search for a cause of the 29 Oct move beyond the Danske note: no company release, and the sector moved less.
Search for a 2030 strategy presentation date or capital markets day: none announced.

Search for the SJF Q3 2025 release (date and reaction): the date was not recovered. Quartr gives 9M 2025 pre-tax DKK 603.8m and the narrowed guide; another snippet gives 635.5m, a figure that conflicts.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The baseline's reaction history as the event scale (median 1.57%)
rejected_candidates.detail: The baseline's estimated dates miss the actual release days: Q1 was 2026-05-07, not 05-13, and H1 was 08-13, which matches. So it is not used as a scale. The actual release days moved +0.47% and -1.37%.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the lean. The run-up (+10.7% over 20 days, +17% since the pre-upgrade close) and two sell-side or company catalysts already in the price argue that a confirming release has little left to give. Nothing found argues for a large move in either direction.
language_note: The upgrade's exact wording ('basisindtjeningen udvikler sig bedre end forventet'), the in-session release clock (10.08 and 11.07 local) and the strategy timing ('forventes offentliggjort i fjerde kvartal 2026') all come from Danish-only company releases and the Danish H1 report. SJF publishes its releases in Danish only, so the English sources carry only AI summaries of them, and those mislabel periods.
The only trace of the 29 Oct Danske Bank note and its +23.7% NII 2027 estimate is a Norwegian-language Nordnet retail forum. No English or Danish press carried it.
lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the buyback finding went from +0.1 to 0.0. No reported-quarter finding was filed, because the 12 Oct raise pre-released Q3.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct went from 2.5 to 3.0, the European base for a pre-released period with a guide not expected to move, rather than the name's own ~1.5% results-day moves.
The session lesson confirmed the bmo verdict, written first with timestamps: the releases land mid-morning inside the close(D-1)->close(D) window.
